{{Quote|The Dark Lord Revan is dead. I am a servant of the light now.|Revan|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]], near the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|end]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a '''duel''' took place between ex-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]&mdash;who was now the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]&mdash;and the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who was now a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|redeemed]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;and his fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jolee Bindo]] and [[Juhani]]. Shan confronted Revan and his companions on the roof of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Temple of the Ancients|Temple]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], as they were attempting to shut off the [[disruptor field]] that originated from the temple, so the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] could successfully [[Battle of Rakata Prime|assault]] the Star Forge [[Space station/Legends|space station]] which was fueling the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire's]] war effort. Revan, Bindo, and Juhani nearly defeated Shan. However, Shan attempted to persuade Revan to reclaim his former status as Sith Lord. Revan rejected her offer and confirmed his devotion to the Jedi, causing Shan to flee to the Star Forge aboard a [[G-Type light shuttle|starship]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You are strong child, but I will break you.''"<br />"''I'll never fall to the dark side. [Groans from pain of torture] You think torture will turn me Malak? You are a fool.''"<br />"''Torture? No, dear Bastila, you misunderstand. This is but a taste of the dark side to whet your appitite. When you finally swear loyalty to me, it will be willingly.''"<br />"''Never!''"<br />"''Such resolve in your words, but I see the truth in your heart. The dark side calls to you, Bastila. You hunger to taste it. Become my apprentice, and all its power can be yours!|Darth Malak convincing [[Bastila Shan]] to turn to the dark side|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
[[File:Bastila-Malak.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Darth Malak turning Jedi Bastila Shan to the dark side]]
In [[3956 BBY]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="KotOR CG" /> [[Bastila Shan]] was defeated aboard the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']] and taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Malak took her to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> where she rejected Malak's continued attempts to turn her. But after subjecting her to endless [[Torture/Legends|torture]] for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], Malak eventually succeeded in forcing her to give in to her hate and fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. He convinced her that the [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Jedi Council]] was holding her back and using her, and in retaliation she took her place as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], replacing the [[Death/Legends|slain]] [[Darth Bandon]].<ref name="KotOR game" /> Revan had found and collected the five [[Star Map]]s he needed to locate the Star Forge, but as the [[Ebon Hawk]] approached the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], a [[disruptor field]] damaged its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and the ship barely avoided a crash landing on the planet's surface. Juhani suggested to the group that they should search the other downed ships for the parts the Ebon Hawk needed to repair the hyperdrive, but the disruptor field still needed to be deactivated. The whereabouts of the generator was found by the [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] [[T3-M4]], which detected energy readings on the ship's sensors that seemed to be coming from the nearby Temple of the Ancients.<ref name="KotOR game" />

Revan was assaulted by [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] warriors of the [[Black Rakata|Rakatan tribe]], but after seeing Revan's power, he and his crew were granted an audience with [[the One]]. The One told Revan about his [[Mission to Rakata Prime|original promise]] to kill [[Elders (Rakatan)|The Elders]] and gain their secrets to enter the Temple of the Ancients. Revan sought out the Elder tribe, when the Elder Council revealed how brutal and warlike the One and his tribe were, Revan and his crew decided to help the Elders instead. The Elder Council was very reluctant to trust Revan again due to his betrayal the last time they had met. They tasked Revan with rescuing an Elder scout from the [[Black Rakatan Settlement|One's enclave]] in order to regain their trust. Upon arriving at the One's enclave, the One and his tribe turned on Revan and his crew. The entire tribe fell under Revan's prowess, and he freed the scout. After gaining the support of the Elders, they granted Revan access to the Temple, but their tradition was that he had to go alone. While he was waiting with the Rakatan priest for them to lower the shield, both Juhani and Bindo received a [[Force vision/Legends|premonition]] warning them of great danger laying inside, they insisted on accompanying Revan and struggled to persuade the Rakata priest to forgo tradition and allow the three inside. It turned out to be the right decision, as the temple was infested with numerous [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Masters]], [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]], and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] who had been left there by Darth Malak and Revan when they first gained entrance to the temple. They discovered an ancient [[computer terminal]] which gave them the secrets to the Star Forge and the way to disable the disruptor field that brought them down to Rakata Prime in the first place. When the redeemed Jedi Revan came to the summit to deactivate the shield, which prevented the Ebon Hawk from taking off, along with Bindo and Juhani, they encountered what they least expected: their former companion Shan, corrupted by the dark side.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==The Duel==
{{Dialogue|Bastila Shan|Revan &ndash; I knew you'd come for me. Malak thought you might be afraid to enter the Temple again, but he doesn't know you like I do. Not anymore. Not since you've changed.|Juhani|Quickly, Bastila &ndash; come with us! We have to escape before Malak arrives!|Bastila|Escape? You don't understand. I have sworn allegiance to Lord Malak and the Sith; I am no longer a pawn of the Jedi Council.|Revan|No, Bastila! Don't go over to the dark side!|Shan|You say that as if the dark side is some terrible entity. The Jedi Council has brainwashed you like all the others. Like they once did with me. They speak of the dark side as if it is something to be feared. But in reality their only goal is to manipulate those who are strong in the Force. The fear of the dark side is a tool to maintain control. Why do you think the Jedi forbid you and Malak from joining the Mandalorian Wars? They knew you would realize your true potential and break free of their domination. Malak has shown me how the Jedi Council have been using me the same way they once tried to use you. They've been holding me back because they knew one day I would surpass them all.|Revan|It's not too late, Bastila! You can still turn away from the dark side!||attr=Bastila Shan, Juhani, and Revan before their duel|src=<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
[[File:Unkwldtemple.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Temple of the Ancients]]
{{GameLS}}
Shan reunited with Revan, Bindo, and Juhani atop the Temple, though under unexpected circumstances. Shan told them that after the torture she'd endured, she had sworn allegiance to Malak and was now his apprentice, declaring that she would aid Malak in taking over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. She engaged all three of them in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], but was no match for the three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Shan threw a Force wave at them in order to save herself from defeat.<ref name="KotOR game" />

After seeing how powerful Revan was despite what the Council had done to him, she came to believe Revan deserved to be the Dark Lord of the Sith. Shan attempted to persuade him to reclaim his former title and to take her as his apprentice, reminding Revan of all the things the Jedi Council had done to him. Revan was forced to come to terms with the dark legacy of his former self, and was faced with a decision that could alter the course of the galaxy. Shan reminded him that she could sense his thoughts through the bond linking them. Revan stated that there was something more than the bond between them: their love for one another. Shan denied this, however, claiming that the only thing between them was [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and power. Shan pleaded for Revan to join her, to reclaim the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and take revenge on Malak for his betrayal. Revan demanded to know how he could trust her after she had betrayed him. Shan informed him that she could not deny herself anything anymore, and would stand by his side forever as his lover and apprentice. She told Revan that they could defeat Malak together. Revan calmed himself, his resolve strengthened by Bindo and Juhani, and made the choice of a true Jedi rejecting Shan's offer of power. Angered at her failure to turn Revan, Shan retreated to the Star Forge where she and Revan had their [[Battle of Rakata Prime|final battle]].<ref name="KotOR game" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Juhani|Bastila, it is not too late for you to be saved. The teachings of the Jedi can lead you from the dark side back into the light and a true understanding of the Force.|Bastila|You are beneath my contempt, Juhani. When you felt the power of the dark side you fled to a cave like some cowering animal! You know nothing of the Force or its true potential! But you, Revan &ndash; the power of the dark side is yours to command! You can use it to destroy Malak! With my help you could rule over the entire galaxy!|Revan|The Dark Lord Revan is dead. I am a servant of the light now.|Bastila|You are a pathetic fool, Revan! Together we could have defeated Malak and ruled over an Empire, but now I will be at Lord Malak's side instead! You will be crushed with the Republic and all the fools who bow down to the Jedi Council! No one can stand against the power of the Star Forge and the Sith fleet!|attr=Bastila Shan attempts to turn Revan, while he and Juhani attempt to redeem her|src=<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
Revan deactivated the disruptor field generated from the summit. He and his crew repaired the Ebon Hawk and followed Shan to the Star Forge as a Republic Fleet dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and commenced an assault on the Star Forge. The surviving Jedi [[Attack on Dantooine|from]] [[Jedi Enclave|Dantooine's destroyed enclave]] boarded the Star Forge in hopes of disrupting Bastila's [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] so that the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|Republic capital ships]] could close in on the space station to destroy it. Aboard the Star Forge, Revan displayed his restored affinity for the Force and his mastery of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by nearly single-handedly confronting and defeating all of Malak's army of Star Forge battle droids and Dark Jedi. In the Star Forge's command center, Revan faced off against Shan once again, this time, alone. Though she was able to draw on the Star Forge to renew her strength, Revan still bested her. She begged Revan to kill her after all she had done, but Revan attempted to convince her to return to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] by drawing on the powerful bond of love they shared. He succeeded, and Shan used her battle meditation to aid the Republic, turning the tide of the climactic battle. Revan went on to defeat his former apprentice and save the galaxy.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Dark side ending===
{{Dialogue|Revan|Yes! Together we can rule the galaxy!|Jolee|Listen to me&hellip; the dark side leads to death and destruction. I've seen the horrors the Sith have unleashed on the galaxy. Turn away from this path.|Bastila|Shut up, old man. Your time is over! The age of the Jedi and the Republic is no more! This is the age of Darth Revan and the Sith!|Jolee|Don't do this, kid. I don't want to, but I'll fight you if I have to, even if it costs me my life!|Revan|I am the Lord of the Sith! Bow down before me!|Juhani|A true Jedi will never bow down to the Sith. If this is your decision I have no choice but to do battle against you.|Bastila|Kill her! Rend her flesh! Show her the fate of all who dare stand against us! Embrace the power of the dark side!|Revan|Death to the Jedi!|Bastila|Yes! The sacrificial blood will consecrate this ancient temple in the name of the Sith! With the death of the Jedi the rebirth of Darth Revan will be complete!|attr=Darth Revan accepts Bastila's offer and turns on his former companions|src=<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
[[File:Truelordofthesith.jpg|thumb|right|200px|"The true Lord of the Sith!"]]
Accepting Bastila Shan's offer, Revan struck down the Jedi Jolee Bindo and Juhani (only Jolee if Juhani had been killed on Dantooine), the stain of their blood on the temple stone symbolizing Revan's return to power. He returned to the ''Ebon Hawk'' and explained the absences of Bindo and Juhani to his stunned party.
Revan and Bastila offered the rest of the team the chance to join them. The droids [[HK-47]] and T3-M4 were programmed to do so, and [[Canderous Ordo]] pledged his loyalty to the man he believed would bring him battles in which he could find the honor he had been looking for, as he had in the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Mission Vao]] refused to believe that Revan had returned to the dark side and did not run away. [[Zaalbar]] initially agreed to join the dark side as he owed Revan a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] and even agreed (via a mind trick from Revan) to kill Mission to prove his loyalty.<ref name="KotOR game" /> (Note that the player could fail to persuade Zaalbar to attack Mission; in this case, the player must personally engage Mission, and kill Zaalbar as well.)<ref name="KotOR game" />

Before approaching the Star Forge, Shan tricked the Republic to into attacking the Sith fleet there as a preliminary measure to defeat the Republic. The Republic believed that she would use her battle meditation against the Sith, but she turned it against them just before Revan faced Malak. Master [[Vandar Tokare]] realized the truth just after Shan applied her battle meditation against the Jedi, but could do nothing to stop her. On the Command Deck Revan faced Malak's [[Blue-robed Dark Jedi|three]] [[Gray-robed Dark Jedi|most]] [[Red-robed Dark Jedi|powerful]] Dark Jedi (each with different robes). Malak promised that the one who delivered the killing blow to Revan would become his new apprentice. Revan and Bastila fought and killed all three of them. After Revan defeated Malak, he re-assumed the title of Dark Lord of the Sith and made Shan his apprentice and lover. Together, they set out to conquer the galaxy.<ref name="KotOR game" />

Using the resources he now commanded as Master of the Star Forge, Darth Revan created an infinite fleet that rolled forth to crush the Republic.<ref name="KotOR game" /> Surprisingly, however, Darth Revan soon halted his offensive. It was noted as odd that Revan deliberately avoided striking the Republic's manufacturing facilities in his previous war, and again that he seemingly ended the Star Forge's production of vessels early.

Shortly after defeating Malak, Darth Revan returned to Korriban, in an effort to unite the Sith to crush the Republic once and for all.During his time on Korriban, Darth Revan started recovering his lost memories, eventually recovering all of his former memories and remembering the threat that he discovered during the Mandalorian Wars, fearing that might threaten his power, so one day he left mysteriously, leading his empire to its downfall.

Bereft of a strong dark side user to guide it, the [[Star Forge]] went dormant, stopping all production and activity, after misuse from lesser Sith Lords who tried to tap into its power. Before his departure, Darth Revan confessed his fears and thoughts to Shan.

However, Bastila Shan installed secret commands into T3-M4. She knew that Revan would not take her into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], fearing their bond would be a weakness to him. She also knew that Revan would take T3. She ordered the droid to return to known space should something happen to Revan. If T3 was unable to locate her, the droid was to find anyone, Sith or Jedi, who could help. She ordered T3 to keep this last command a secret from her master Revan.<ref name="The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Shan, left behind, seeing disorder among the Sith&mdash;and seeing none left with the power to control the Star Forge, devouring those too weak to harness its power&mdash;realized that Revan never intended to keep the Star Forge operational. She recorded her concerns in a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] placed in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]&mdash;shortly before the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], along with most of the [[Sith Order|Order]], [[Sith Civil War|completely collapsed]]. At the end of the holocron, Shan stated that she was leaving for the Unknown Regions to find and bring Revan back. It had not yet been proven if she left before Korriban fell into ruin, or died there before leaving.<ref name="The Sith Lords" />

It was assumed that Darth Revan visited all his former strongholds searching for something that is was not readily apparent. It is known, however, that he headed for the Unknown Regions with the intent of stopping something menacingly powerful, something that was apparently responsible for initially coercing the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to invade. Revan's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Kreia]], suggested that Revan was searching for the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', Revan's allegiance can be determined in Meetra Surik's first conversation with Atton Rand.</ref> believed to be destroyed in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].
